description: LUD-26 key-path notes (lnurl/luds 92e430f). Every branch is a BIP39 seed (no passphrase) at one host. domain is the host's lowercase name without its port; cashHashingKey is the private key at m/139'/0, domainIndices the four raw uint32 read big-endian from HMAC-SHA256(cashHashingKey, utf8(domain)), used as BIP-32 indices exactly as they fall, and serviceRoot S = m/139'/d1/d2/d3/d4 as privateKey||chainCode hex. Below S everything is plain BIP-32: account a's wallet notes at S/a'/0/i, its change at S/a'/1/i, and share n at S/a'/2/n', exported as cx1 = bech32m("cx", chainCode || P compressed), 65 bytes; share notes S/a'/2/n'/i equal CKDpub from the cx1 alone. A note's noteSecretKey is the BIP-32 private key at its path, notePubkeyCompressed its point, and notePubkey = Q = x(point), with no BIP-86 tweak. sighash is the BIP-341 key-path sighash of input 0 of the canonical spend transaction for domain, keyPathSignature BIP-340 with an all-zero aux_rand (the signer negates the key for an odd-y point), ck1 = bech32m("ck", Q || signature). certificates are recoverable ECDSA by the mint key over sha256(sha256("Lightning Signed Message:" || "LNURLcash:<domain>:<amount_msat>:<hex(Q)>")), HRP "cs" plus the BOLT-11 amount; legacyCertificates are the superseded message without the domain, which a wallet still reads. addressProofs are BIP-340 (all-zero aux_rand) by the share's own key over sha256 of "LNURLcash:register:<domain>:<username>:<cx1>", "LNURLcash:update:<domain>:<username>:<new cx1>" (by the key on file) or "LNURLcash:unregister:<domain>:<username>", the username lowercased; a PUT carries an update sig and a register newsig by the new share. legacy records the superseded tweak schemes, for sweeping only.

conventions.domainHashed: the host's lowercase name without its port, the string the canonical spend transaction commits to
conventions.cx1Payload: chainCode (32) || P (33, compressed), BIP-32 order, 113 characters
conventions.spendDomain: the host's lowercase name, never its scheme or port
conventions.canonicalSpendTransaction: nVersion 2; vin[0] prevout (tagged_hash("LNURLcash/mint", domain), 0), empty scriptSig, nSequence 0xffffffff; vout[0] value 0, empty scriptPubKey; nLockTime 0; spent output (OP_1 <Q>, 0)
conventions.ck1Signs: tagged_hash("TapSighash", 0x00 || SigMsg), the BIP-341 key-path sighash (SIGHASH_DEFAULT, spend_type 0x00) of input 0 of the canonical spend transaction for the domain
conventions.keyPathSignature: BIP-340 Schnorr, 64 bytes, all-zero aux_rand, so a ck1 is a deterministic function of the key and the domain
conventions.addressProofSigner: the share's own key p at S/a'/2/n', verified against x(P) of the cx1 being registered, or of the one on file
conventions.addressProofEncoding: UTF-8, username lowercased, sha256-hashed to 32 bytes, BIP-340 with an all-zero aux_rand
conventions.cs1Payload: r || s || recovery-id, 65 bytes, recovery-id 0 to 3

legacy.description: The tweak schemes before LUD-26 (luds a6c4652), for one mnemonic at every host, so a wallet can find and sweep notes it derived under them. node is m/139'/d1/d2/d3/d4 for the host exactly as stored, port included; cx1 is the 64-byte bech32m("cx", x(P) || chainCode). notes: t = tagged_hash("LNURLcash/derive", x(P) || chainCode || ser32(purpose) || ser32(index)) mod n (luds 50d740a, purposes 0 wallet, 1 change, 2 Lightning Address); prePurpose: the same without ser32(purpose) (luds 6e865b1). notePubkey = x(lift_x(x(P)) + t·G), noteSecretKey = ((P even ? p : n - p) + t) mod n.
